spec_metadata.name: Aluminum Siding Exterior Repaint
spec_metadata.description: Repaint of existing exterior aluminum siding. Two substrate states (SS_EXT_SOUND_PAINT + SS_EXT_CHALKING), self-etching primer always required (phosphoric acid + zinc — NOT STIX adhesion), chalk_severity drives prep labor intensity, DFT-critical primer application (0.5-1.0 mil max), coastal epoxy intermediate layer conditional. QT2-QT3 only — aluminum is not a fine-finish substrate. Spray primary with brush detail at J-channels (QT3). No LRV restriction — any color permitted. No warranty void gate. No RRP gate.

includes: Pressure wash with TSP/alkaline cleaner (mandatory first production step)
Chalk verification gate (hand-rub test — mandatory pass before scuff/prime)
Oxide layer scuff with synthetic 180-320 grit abrasive pads
Self-etching primer (phosphoric acid + zinc) — full coverage, single coat, always required
DFT verification gate — primer must be 0.5-1.0 mil (over-application = cohesive failure)
Epoxy intermediate coat (COASTAL ONLY — salt-air corrosion barrier)
Finish coat application (1 coat QT2, 2 coats QT3) — 100% acrylic latex
J-channel and under-sill brush detail (QT3 only)
Caulk assessment and replacement at siding-to-trim joints (QT3 only)
Landscape and hardscape protection (plastic sheeting, drop cloths — extended for chalk wash runoff)
Window, door, and trim masking for spray operations
Light fixture, HVAC unit, and utility panel masking
excludes: Replacement of dented, bent, or punctured aluminum panels (replacement scope, not painting)
Window or door painting (separate spec scopes)
Lead paint abatement (aluminum factory-baked enamel was never lead-based)

config_dimensions.description: QT2 = economy (wash, self-etching prime, single finish coat). QT3 = standard (TSP wash with chalk verification, self-etching prime, two finish coats, J-channel detail, caulk assessment). QT4/QT5 excluded — aluminum siding is not a fine-finish substrate.

Drives PREP LABOR TIME, not primer chemistry. none = standard wash. light = TSP wash + chalk removal verification (1.25x prep modifier). heavy = multiple wash passes + mechanical scrubbing + extended dwell + mandatory re-verification (1.75x prep modifier). Replaces lrv_class from vinyl sibling. All paths converge at complete chalk removal before priming.
config_dimensions.notes: Drives PREP LABOR TIME, not primer chemistry. none = standard wash. light = TSP wash + chalk removal verification (1.25x prep modifier). heavy = multiple wash passes + mechanical scrubbing + extended dwell + mandatory re-verification (1.75x prep modifier). Replaces lrv_class from vinyl sibling. All paths converge at complete chalk removal before priming. Mapped to universal condition scale: none=GOOD(1.0x), light=FAIR(1.5x), heavy=POOR(2.0x).

config_dimensions.description: Per-elevation access type drives FAC_EXT_ACCESS height modifier on variable-rate tasks. Scaffold preferred over ladder for multi-story aluminum to improve DFT control stability during spray.

paintable_items.name: Exterior siding field surface
paintable_items.notes: Shared with SF_WOOD_SIDING_EXT_NC_PAINT, SF_SIDING_FIBERCEMENT_EXT_NC, SF_SIDING_VINYL_EXT_RP. Net paintable siding field area in square feet.

material_systems.name: Self-Etching Primer (Phosphoric Acid + Zinc)

applies_when.condition: always — self-etching primer is mandatory regardless of substrate state or quality tier

material_systems.notes: MANDATORY for ALL aluminum siding repaints. Phosphoric acid etches Al2O3 oxide layer, zinc provides galvanic corrosion resistance. DFT MUST be 0.5-1.0 mil — over-application causes cohesive failure. STIX-class adhesion primers and standard bonding primers do NOT work on aluminum oxide. Single coat only, fine-atomization spray tips required.

material_systems.name: Epoxy Intermediate Primer (Coastal Conditional)

applies_when.condition: CONDITIONAL — only when site assessment indicates marine/harsh coastal salt-air exposure

material_systems.notes: Creates three-layer corrosion barrier: self-etch -> epoxy -> acrylic. Salt air penetrates standard acrylic topcoat to primer-metal interface without this barrier. Non-coastal projects skip entirely.

material_systems.name: 100% Acrylic Exterior Latex — All Colors

applies_when.condition: always — single finish system for all colors, no LRV restriction

material_systems.notes: Any color permitted — aluminum conducts heat efficiently, no thermal warping risk. No LRV-class material branching (simpler than vinyl's standard vs IR-reflective split). 100% acrylic latex binder for durability and flexibility.

modules.name: Pressure Wash with TSP / Alkaline Cleaner

tasks.name: Pressure Wash Aluminum Siding
tasks.notes: FAC_ALRP_CHALK modifier applies: none=1.00x, light=1.25x, heavy=1.75x

modules.name: Surface Preparation — Chalk Verify, Oxide Scuff, Dust Cleanup

tasks.name: Chalk Verification Gate
tasks.notes: MANDATORY GATE. Hand-rub test with dark cloth. Any white transfer = re-wash required. Must pass before scuff/prime proceeds.

tasks.name: Oxide Layer Scuff — 180-320 Grit
tasks.notes: Mechanically break Al2O3 oxide film. Synthetic pads ONLY — no steel wool. TIMING: must prime within 4-8 hours (2-4 hours coastal). FAC_ALRP_CHALK modifier applies.

tasks.name: DFT Verification — Self-Etching Primer
tasks.notes: CRITICAL QC GATE. DFT must be 0.5-1.0 mil. Over-application (>1.0 mil) = cohesive failure = strip and re-prime.

tasks.name: J-Channel and Detail Brush Work
tasks.notes: Estimate at 5-10% of total field SF as detail SF. Covers J-channels, under-sill channels, corner transitions, and trim cut-in.

tasks.name: DFT Verification — Finish Coat System
tasks.notes: Verify total system DFT (primer + finish coats). Less critical than primer DFT but confirms adequate film build.

tasks.name: Clean Spray Equipment
tasks.notes: Critical flush between self-etching primer and acrylic finish — cross-contamination causes adhesion issues. Both tip sets cleaned individually.

tasks.name: Final Site Cleanup & Demobilization
tasks.notes: No RRP waste disposal — aluminum factory enamel is not lead-based.

round_configurations.description: Self-etching prime (1 coat, 0.5-1.0 mil) + 1 finish coat — economy aluminum repaint
round_configurations.notes: Minimum viable aluminum repaint. Self-etching primer mandatory. Single finish coat. No detail module. No caulk. Total: 2 coating passes.

round_configurations.description: Self-etching prime (1 coat, 0.5-1.0 mil) + 2 finish coats — standard aluminum repaint
round_configurations.notes: Standard residential repaint. Two finish coats + J-channel detail + caulk assessment. Total: 3 coating passes + detail.

round_configurations.description: Self-etching prime (1 coat) + epoxy intermediate (1 coat) + 1 finish coat — coastal economy
round_configurations.notes: Coastal variant adds epoxy intermediate. Three-layer corrosion barrier: self-etch -> epoxy -> acrylic. Total: 3 coating passes.

round_configurations.description: Self-etching prime (1 coat) + epoxy intermediate (1 coat) + 2 finish coats — coastal standard
round_configurations.notes: Coastal variant with full coat system. Four coating layers. J-channel detail. Total: 4 coating passes + detail.

factor_modifiers.name: Quality Tier Rate Modifier
factor_modifiers.notes: QT2=0.85 (economy, less care). QT3=1.00 (baseline standard). No QT4/QT5. Does NOT apply to prep tasks — chalk severity handles prep variation.

factor_modifiers.name: Chalk Severity Rate Modifier
factor_modifiers.notes: PREP TASKS ONLY. Chalk severity drives prep labor time, not primer chemistry. Heavy chalk (1.75x) reflects multiple wash passes, more aggressive scuffing, extended dust cleanup. Does NOT stack with FAC_ALRP_QT — separate modifier pools.

factor_modifiers.name: Access Type Height Modifier
factor_modifiers.notes: Shared across exterior specs. Applied per elevation. Protection, equipment setup/cleanup, chalk verification, DFT verification, and fixed admin tasks are NOT affected.

protection_zones.description: Adjacent landscape beds, shrubs, and plantings — extended for chalk-laden wash runoff
protection_zones.spray_escalation: Extend coverage from 3 ft to 10 ft for spray overspray zone

protection_zones.description: Window glass and frame masking for spray operations
Exterior door masking for spray operations
Trim masking at siding-to-trim transitions for spray
Soffit/fascia at eave junction — overspray protection
protection_zones.notes: Roofline masking handled as part of trim mask setup when soffit is different color from siding.

variants.notes: Baseline economy. No chalk, ground access. Minimum viable aluminum repaint.
Economy light chalk. 1.25x prep modifier on wash/scuff tasks.
Economy heavy chalk. 1.75x prep modifier. Multiple wash passes.
Standard residential. Most common variant. Two finish coats + J-channel detail + caulk assessment.
Standard light chalk. 1.25x prep modifier. TSP wash with chalk verification.
Standard heavy chalk. 1.75x prep modifier. Multiple wash passes + re-wash task. Highest prep cost standard variant.
Standard at ladder height. 1.35x access modifier. Common for 2-story homes.
Standard with scaffold. 1.60x access modifier. Preferred for multi-story to improve DFT compliance.
Highest non-coastal cost variant. Heavy chalk (1.75x) + scaffold (1.60x) on prep tasks = 2.80x. Worst-case standard estimation.
Coastal economy. Three-layer system: self-etch -> epoxy -> acrylic. Total: 3 coating passes.
Coastal standard. Four coating layers + detail. Maximum corrosion protection system.
Coastal standard + heavy chalk. Most expensive variant at ground level. Heavy chalk prep + 4-coat coastal system + detail.

gate_conditions.condition: Dented, bent, or punctured aluminum panels with structural compromise
gate_conditions.reason: Severely damaged aluminum panels must be replaced or straightened before painting. Painting over structural damage traps moisture in deformations and creates differential expansion stress at dent edges. Replacement scope, not painting scope.

gate_conditions.description: DFT over-application on self-etching primer — HARD STOP
gate_conditions.reason: Self-etching primer above 1.0 mil DFT fails cohesively WITHIN the primer film. The acid-etch reaction zone has limited depth — primer beyond that zone has no bond substrate. Must strip over-applied area and re-apply at correct DFT (0.5-1.0 mil). More primer = worse bond (opposite of all other primer systems).

gate_conditions.description: Chalk residue remaining after wash — CONDITIONAL STOP
gate_conditions.condition: Chalk verification test fails (white transfer on dark cloth after wash and dry)
gate_conditions.reason: Residual chalk acts as bond-breaker — self-etching primer acid cannot reach aluminum through chalk residue. Must re-wash until test passes. Cannot proceed to scuff/prime with chalk present.

Acrylic latex provides superior long-term flexibility, color retention, and UV resistance on aluminum. Alkyd/oil over self-etching primer is technically possible but NOT recommended for residential exterior. Use 100% acrylic exterior latex.
gate_conditions.enforced_by: Material specification and QC at delivery

adjacent_surfaces.notes: Soffit at eave line. Different color typically. Separate scope.
Frieze board at siding-to-soffit junction. Trim color. Separate scope.
Corner boards/posts frame siding. Trim color. Siding terminates at corner.
Window casing. Siding terminates at casing. Window masking is this spec's responsibility during spray.
Door casing. Door masking is this spec's responsibility during spray.
Foundation below siding. Not painted in siding scope.

valid_input_states.notes: TWO input states (vs vinyl's one). SS_EXT_SOUND_PAINT: existing coating adhered, minimal chalk. SS_EXT_CHALKING: existing coating chalky but adhered. Both states are repaintable. Both require self-etching primer (chemistry does not change). State drives chalk_severity assessment and prep modifier (1.10x for sound, 1.40x for chalking on base prep tasks).

output_state.notes: Output state determined by sheen selection.

sequencing_notes.production_sequence: Setup → Protect → Wash → Dry (24-48 hr) → Chalk Verify Gate → Scuff Oxide → Dust Cleanup → Caulk (QT3) → Prime Self-Etch → DFT Verify Primer → [Epoxy Coastal] → Finish 1 → Inspect → Touch-Up → [Finish 2 QT3] → [Detail QT3] → [DFT Verify Finish QT3] → Final Inspect → Cleanup
sequencing_notes.critical_timing: Scuff-to-prime MUST be same-day (4-8 hr window, 2-4 hr coastal). Oxide reforms rapidly on exposed aluminum. 24-48 hr dry time between wash and scuff is scheduling overhead.
sequencing_notes.edge_work: No edge work in this spec. Siding terminates at aluminum J-channels and corner trim. Cut-in at trim junctions handled by MOD_ALRP_DETAIL (QT3 only).
sequencing_notes.protection_sequence: Landscape/hardscape protection → Window/door masking (spray) → Trim masking (spray) → Fixture masking → HVAC cover → Utility panel masking → Coating work → Protection teardown
sequencing_notes.coat_sequence: Self-etching primer (always, single coat, DFT-critical) → [Epoxy intermediate, coastal only] → Finish coat 1 → [Finish coat 2, QT3] → [J-channel detail, QT3]
sequencing_notes.elevation_strategy: Work one elevation at a time. Same-day scuff-to-prime per elevation. Per-elevation access type allows mixed-height estimation.
sequencing_notes.key_prohibitions: NO steel wool (ferrous contamination). NO STIX adhesion primer (wrong chemistry). NO self-etching primer above 1.0 mil DFT. NO priming if chalk verification fails. NO delay >8 hours between scuff and prime.

cycles.notes: Economy single-coat repaint. Self-etching primer + 1 finish coat. Acceptable for rental/pre-sale cosmetic refresh.
Standard 2-coat repaint. Self-etching primer + 2 finish coats + detail. Most common residential scenario. Coastal variant with epoxy may extend toward 15-year end.

relationships.cross_spec_protection_note: Window/door masking during aluminum siding spray is THIS spec's responsibility. Trim, soffit, and fascia are separate scopes.

change_log.author: SpecFactory Assembly Agent
change_log.changes: Initial draft spec for exterior aluminum siding repaint. Key features: two substrate states (SS_EXT_SOUND_PAINT + SS_EXT_CHALKING), 3 config dimensions (quality_tier QT2-QT3, chalk_severity none/light/heavy, access_type), 1 paintable item (ITM_SIDING_FIELD), 3 material systems (1 mandatory self-etching primer + 1 conditional epoxy intermediate + 1 finish), 10 modules with 40 tasks (31 binary + 4 qt_scaled + 5 qt_conditional), 3 factor modifiers (FAC_ALRP_QT + FAC_ALRP_CHALK + FAC_EXT_ACCESS) with stacking partition (chalk on prep only, QT on coating only), 10 protection zones, 4 round configurations (QT2/QT3 x standard/coastal), 12 representative variants including coastal combinations, 4 gate conditions (physical damage hard stop, DFT over-application hard stop, chalk residue conditional stop, binder restriction warning). Unique vs vinyl sibling: chalk_severity replaces lrv_class, self-etching primer replaces STIX adhesion, DFT verification gates, coastal epoxy intermediate layer, no LRV gate, no warranty void gate. Max modifier stack: prep 2.80x (heavy chalk + scaffold), coating 2.39x (QT3 + scaffold + sun + temp) — both well under 4.0x cap.
